prompt: I need to capture a GPU frame in Unreal to debug a shader issue. The editor is already running on port 30010. I want to capture the frame and also save a screenshot for comparison.

assertions.name: uses-editor-exec-renderdoc-captureframe
assertions.description: Response mentions `editor exec renderdoc.captureframe` as the GPU capture method

assertions.name: uses-screenshot-capture
assertions.description: Response mentions `screenshot capture` for the visual reference screenshot

assertions.name: mentions-renderdoc-plugin-prerequisite
assertions.description: Response mentions the RenderDoc plugin prerequisite

assertions.name: correct-port-usage
assertions.description: Response uses --port 30010 since the user specified the editor is on that port

assertions.name: explains-rdc-output
assertions.description: Response explains what the .rdc output is and where it goes
